test_title: PYST 13: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 23 Feb, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

My father was very distant, but I suppose all men of his generation _________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**were**" is the plural past tense form of the verb "**be**."
 
• The sentence describes a characteristic of men in a particular generation, and since "**men**" is a plural noun, the plural verb "**were**" is required.
 
• **Options 1, 2**, and 3 are grammatically incorrect in this context.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

**Complete Sentence:** *"My father was very distant, but I suppose all men of his generation **were**__."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "there"** is incorrect because it does not fit in the context of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2: "was"** is incorrect because "was" is used with singular subjects, whereas "men" is plural.
 
• **Option 3: "would"** is incorrect because it does not appropriately complete the sentence in this context.
